title: Machine Learning-Based Short-Term Earthquake Forecasting for the Indian Plate Seismogenic System: A Multi-Zone, Multi-Threshold Ensemble Study with Interpretability and ETAS Benchmarking
description: Code and data for multi-zone, multi-threshold ML earthquake forecasting study on the Indian plate. Includes tabular (LR, BRF, XGB) and deep learning (LSTM, TCN, WaveNet, Transformer) models, ETAS benchmark, SHAP interpretability, and MC-Dropout uncertainty quantification.
